name: arcgentic
description: Moirai-derived gated engineering workflow for AI coding. Arcgentic V2 turns Codex and Claude Code sessions into orchestrated planning, development, self-audit, optional user testing, external audit, and closeout.
author: Arc Studio
status: v2.2.0. Codex V2 is complete and real-machine verified, including automatic Orchestrator setup and role dispatch. Claude Code V2 is complete and real-machine verified for single-session-subagent mode via the native-tooling (Agent) tier-0 broker path; multi-session-subthread mode and the hook-backed fallback remain unverified by that gate. arcgentic also ships an optional MCP server (`arcgentic mcp-serve`, `pip install arcgentic[mcp]`) exposing a round-status panel via MCP Apps.
